notes: Darwin's monotypic genus (Proteolepas bivincta Darwin, 1854); later regarded as a parasitic isopod larva rather than a cirripede. GBIF key 2203053 (Proteolepas Darwin, 1854) has status DOUBTFUL and is placed in Isopoda: Crinoniscidae, consistent with the reinterpretation of Darwin's specimen as an isopod. Not in NCBI Taxonomy.
